summary: Full backend+frontend regression for Rekapin Jan 2026 v5 (Funnel, Users CRUD, Custom Fields, Ratings, Tenancy, Auto-email, Date filter, Send-email, Timeline removal). 10/10 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend Playwright covered admin login, funnel chart, admin nav (User/Setting), tab set (Master Data, Interview, Training, Blacklist, Placement — Timeline gone), Settings page (CF create + Dropdown-type enables options), Users page (create recruiter), Candidate form new fields (email, alamat, pic-email, rating-wajah/komunikasi/kedisiplinan) + custom field rendered, recruiter session hides admin nav and /users & /settings redirect to /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1130 lines — strongly consider splitting into routers (auth.py, users.py, candidates.py, custom_fields.py, email.py, cron.py) as it well exceeds the 700-line guideline.

StarRating renders per-star data-testid as `${parentTestid}-star-${n}` (e.g. `rating-wajah-star-3`) rather than a nested `star-3`. Spec in the review request said 'click star-3' — recommend the main agent align docs/spec to the actual testid format to avoid QA confusion.

`_scope_filter` for recruiters uses pic_email == user_email.lower(); good, but candidate documents are inserted with raw `pic_email` (no forced lowercase). Consider normalizing pic_email to lowercase on write, else Excel/bulk imports with mixed-case PIC email will bypass recruiter visibility.
`update_candidate` diff check uses `user['email'].lower()` for comparing to `pic_email`, but pic_email is not normalized — same inconsistency as above.
`send_email_to_candidate` still runs synchronously (awaits SMTP) inside the request; consider BackgroundTasks like the auto-email path for faster response.

Funnel: 'Placement' bar uses `penempatan_fix` non-empty; a candidate can have penempatan_fix set without ever being in Training — dropoff math could go negative before the `max(...,0)` guard. Not a bug, just semantic caveat.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed users/candidates/custom-fields created during pytest and Playwright were cleaned up via fixture teardown + explicit post-run cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two regression suites live under /app/backend/tests/: test_rekapin_backend.py (v4 features) and test_rekapin_v5.py (v5: funnel, users, custom fields, ratings, tenancy, send-email, date filter). Both use pytest and are safe to re-run — they self-cleanup. Login test creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Note: during Playwright, first admin session query_selector for funnel-chart/nav-users reported FAIL, but subsequent navigations that require those elements to be clickable all succeeded, and visual screenshots on the recruiter session confirmed the funnel + 5 tabs render — the initial FAILs were React render race conditions in my script, not real bugs.
